other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.inorder:
fun inorder :: "'a tree ⇒ 'a list" where
  "inorder Leaf = []" |
  "inorder (Node (l) (x) (r)) = inorder l @ [x] @ inorder r"
formal function definitions.inorder2:
fun inorder2 :: "'a tree ⇒ 'a list ⇒ 'a list" where
  "inorder2 Leaf xs = xs" |
  "inorder2 (Node (l) (x) (r)) xs = inorder2 l (x # inorder2 r xs)"

formal theorem statement: theorem inorder2_inorder: "inorder2 t xs = inorder t @ xs"
